component.alias: UniFi Protect, G6, G5, G4, AI
component.notes:
Any camera adopted in UniFi Protect (G6, G5, G4, AI...), streamed from the Protect console (the UniFi OS console or NVR), not from the camera itself. One component per camera.
SETUP 1) In UniFi Protect's Recording Manager, set the camera's stream to "Standard". Savant plays H.264: "Enhanced" streams H.265, and the camera stays black in the Savant app. 2) In UniFi Protect, open the camera, then Settings, Advanced, and turn on RTSP for the stream quality you want (High is usual). Protect shows an address like rtsps://192.168.5.1:7441/Esg1HhMEGKeVBUnU?enableSrtp The part between the last "/" and the "?" is this camera's stream token. 3) In Blueprint, add one of these components per camera. Savant takes a camera's address from its camera table (Camera, Logical Component, IP Address, User Login, Password, Enable H.264), not from the network connection. In that table, for this camera: IP Address the console's address, port 7447 and the token: 192.168.5.1:7447/Esg1HhMEGKeVBUnU User Login empty Password empty (Protect's RTSP doesn't ask for them) Enable H.264 on: this profile's streams are H.264 only Port 7447 is Protect's plain RTSP. Don't use port 7441 or "?enableSrtp": they encrypt the stream, which Savant can't play.
The thumbnail and fullscreen views play the same stream. For lighter thumbnails with many cameras, use the camera's Medium or Low stream token instead.
